660:     def retire_interrupted_worker(self, attempt):
 661:         # Only the exact manager-issued attempt may reach retained native
 662:         # handles. This function never clears aggregate quarantine history.
 663:         _assert(type(attempt) is _InterruptedRetirement and attempt.delegate is self
 664:                 and attempt.native.port is self and self._interrupted_witness is None,
 665:                 "single_interrupted_worker_retirement")
 666:         manager, native = attempt.manager, attempt.native
 667:         manager._assert_interrupted_active(attempt)
 668:         primitives, worker, pair, read_set = native.primitives, native.worker, native.pair, native.protection
 669:         _assert(pair.closed is False and read_set.released is False
 670:                 and all(h.closed is was_closed for h, value, kind, was_closed in native.handle_states),
 671:                 "confirmed_native_preflight_before_first_os_call")
 672:         _assert(worker.creation_time == primitives._creation_time(native.process),
 673:                 "process_creation_time_changed")
 674:         manager._assert_interrupted_active(attempt)
 675:         _assert(type(pair.forced_stop_attempted) is bool, "exact_existing_pipe_stop_latch")
 676:         if pair.forced_stop_attempted is False:
 677:             pair.forced_stop_attempted = True
 678:             try:
 679:                 pair.forced_process_stop_observed = (
 680:                     primitives._stop_partial_worker(worker, 5000) is True)
 681:             except BaseException as error:
 682:                 pair.forced_stop_error_type = type(error).__name__
 683:                 raise
 684:         # A consumed pipe latch permits only fresh retained-handle observation;
 685:         # worker.shutdown_started cannot authorize a second termination.
 686:         manager._assert_interrupted_active(attempt)
 687:         waited = primitives.api.call("WaitForSingleObject", primitives._owned(native.process), 5000)
 688:         _assert(waited == 0, "process_exit_not_observed")
 689:         manager._assert_interrupted_active(attempt)
 690:         exit_code = primitives.api.ffi.c_uint32()
 691:         primitives.api.checked("GetExitCodeProcess", primitives._owned(native.process),
 692:                                primitives.api.ffi.byref(exit_code))
 693:         _assert(type(exit_code.value) is int and 0 <= exit_code.value < 1 << 32
 694:                 and exit_code.value != 259, "process_still_active_or_invalid_exit")
 695:         manager._assert_interrupted_active(attempt)
 696:         accounting = primitives.api.structure("JOBOBJECT_BASIC_ACCOUNTING_INFORMATION")
 697:         returned = primitives.api.ffi.c_uint32()
 698:         primitives.api.checked("QueryInformationJobObject", primitives._owned(native.job), 1,
 699:                                primitives.api.ffi.byref(accounting), primitives.api.ffi.sizeof(accounting),
 700:                                primitives.api.ffi.byref(returned))
 701:         _assert(returned.value == primitives.api.ffi.sizeof(accounting)
 702:                 and accounting.active_processes == 0, "job_active_processes_not_zero")
 703:         manager._assert_interrupted_active(attempt)
 704:         worker.quiescent = True
 705:         self.exit_observation = {"child_native_exit": int(exit_code.value),
 706:             "process_wait_observed": True, "job_active_processes": 0}
 707: 
 708:         # Preserve the original endpoint -> worker -> guard closure order.
 709:         # Closed optional clients/duplicates were already checked at preflight.
 710:         for handle in (native.client, native.server, native.thread, native.process, native.job) + tuple(reversed(native.members)):
 711:             manager._assert_interrupted_active(attempt)
 712:             if handle is not None and handle.closed is False:
 713:                 primitives._close(handle)
 714:         manager._assert_interrupted_active(attempt)
 715:         _assert(all(h.closed is True and h.unconfirmed is False
 716:                     for h, value, kind, was_closed in native.handle_states),
 717:                 "every_retained_native_owner_confirmed_closed")
 718:         pair.closed = True
 719:         read_set.released = True
 720:         witness = _InterruptedRetirementWitness(attempt, native,
 721:             tuple(row[0] for row in native.handle_states), True, int(exit_code.value), 0)
 722:         self._interrupted_witness = witness
 723:         _require_interrupted_witness(attempt, witness)
 724:         return witness
